_doc: Production serving latency budget (REUSE of the L1 `sequence` slide-type, NOT a widget). The per-hop ms are REPRESENTATIVE serving figures; the SUMS are the gated exact computations: critical path 3+8+12+60+4 = 87 ms (< 200 ms SLA, headroom 113), all hops incl. the async cache+log tail 89 ms. An EXACT scan of 10⁶×768-d would cost the exactScanMs below — the search hop alone blows the budget. A cache hit returns in ≈ cacheHitMs. Caching + quantization are the levers (callback L1 MLSD; the L7 cross-encoder cascade now sits BEHIND ANN retrieval).
_source: _research/gen_l9.py (toy, stdlib): total = Σ lat. Per-hop + exactScan/cacheHit are representative.

cacheHitBudget._doc: Warm path (cache hit): the per-hop ms are representative, but cacheHitMs is the gated exact SUM 3+1+1 = 5 ms — no ANN search, no rerank.

tailNote._doc: Representative serving-latency tier: p50/p99 of a warm ANN+rerank tier. Flagged representative (illustrative, not measured in this repo) — the tail (p99) is what an SLA is written against.
